text:
Hello everyone,

I am sending an urgent operational reminder for the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. The volume of routine checks, carrier reviews, and traveler confirmations continues to demand disciplined handling, and each file must be kept current before any move is approved. Please continue to treat every journey as a shared responsibility, with careful attention to pet welfare, routing consistency, and the documentation that supports a smooth transfer from intake to departure.

Escalations must continue through the calm stepwise review process already in place. Do not bypass the standard sequence unless there is a clear welfare concern that requires immediate visibility. When records are incomplete, when kennel notes conflict with traveler declarations, or when a pet's preparation appears uncertain, pause and elevate the case through the proper internal channel. The goal is to resolve issues early, reduce last-minute disruption, and protect the reliability of our desk work across all active files. I need everyone to remain precise in notes, steady in tone, and ready to support one another where coverage becomes uneven.

Please also keep communication with travelers clear, factual, and courteous. If a handoff requires clarification, document it fully and keep the response aligned with current service practice. Verify forms, confirm acceptance details, and ensure that every update is reflected in the shared record without delay. We cannot afford drift in a process that depends on consistency. Maintain close attention to the next review cycle, keep your queues current, and bring any unusual situation forward at once so we can act before it becomes a broader issue. Thank you for your focus and for the care you bring to this work every day.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
